description: This Java class `DefaultHealthCheckConfig` implements `HealthCheckConfig` and provides configuration handling for health checks, including loading settings from a Typesafe Config object, managing nested configurations, and defining properties such as enablement, interval, and persistence configuration.

classes.name: DefaultHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: A final immutable class implementing `HealthCheckConfig` that encapsulates health check settings, loaded from configuration, including basic health check and persistence configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of `DefaultHealthCheckConfig` from a given Typesafe `Config`, extracting nested configurations for basic health check and persistence.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the health check is enabled, delegated from `basicHealthCheckConfig`.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for health checks, delegated from `basicHealthCheckConfig`.

methods.name: getPersistenceConfig
methods.description: Provides access to the persistence configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides `Object.equals` to compare `DefaultHealthCheckConfig` instances based on internal configuration objects.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration object including its nested configs.
